verdicts.reason: A: one oversized can on the left plus two tiny cans with unreadable labels jammed in the bottom-right; CTA pushed to the top corner above the headline; flavour names, body copy, delivery line and descriptors are crammed into one tight right column with no gaps; the descriptors no longer sit with their flavours; large dead area bottom-left. B: the three cans differ in size and height, so the row looks arbitrary; flavour names and descriptors are split into two separate lists in mismatched order (Honey Rosemary is followed by Bright & zesty); the text stack is cramped. Its headline-then-CTA order and centred axis still make it less broken than A.
